title: Unkar Plutt
description: As the junkboss of Niima Outpost on Jakku, Unkar Plutt was a hulking Crolute who traded portions of food in exchange for scavenged bits of technological scraps found in the wreckage of old battleships. Called the Blobfish behind his back, he was the owner of the Millennium Falcon until it was stolen out from under him by Rey and Finn as they escaped the First Order.
